subject: Follow-up: Decision criteria, procurement steps, and SLA targets for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbushealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + asks: decision criteria & procurement timeline

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great discussion. Quick recap and three asks so we can align internally and share a concise response with procurement: 

Summary (call highlights)
- Primary use case: real-time summarization + triage of patient support chats (peak bursts during 8am-6pm PT).
- Current pain: unpredictable latency at scale, token cost spikes during peak windows.
- Deployment preference: prefer hosted initially; exploring Dedicated pools for predictable SLA after pilot.

Three asks from your side we want to confirm:
1) Decision criteria — Can you confirm the top 3 criteria you’ll use to choose a vendor (e.g., 95th percentile latency, per-token cost target, security posture/SOC2)?
2) Economic buyer & procurement path — who signs the contract and who owns procurement? Any required procurement documents/process (PO, SOW, vendor security package)?
3) Timeline — target decision date / pilot start window?

Next steps from Redwood: we’ll share a short matrix comparing Hosted vs Dedicated across latency, cost, and SLAs + a draft SLA and security summary (SOC2 pointers) — will send by Monday. Also looping Marissa to support contract/discount conversations.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0147

Attachments: Nimbus_Security_Summary.pdf (one-page), Draft_SLA_Redwood_v1.docx (SLA draft placeholder)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@procurement.nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + asks: decision criteria & procurement timeline

Thanks Vanessa — that captures it well. Quick answers inline: 

1) Decision criteria (ranked):
- Security/compliance (SOC2 + vendor attestations) — must meet our controls checklist
- 95th percentile latency under load: target <= 350ms for 1–2k qps bursts
- Total cost of ownership for pilot (incl. egress / avg tokens): target <$0.015 per effective query

2) Economic buyer / procurement path:
- Economic buyer: me (CTO) for pilot decisions; final sign-off moves to VP of Ops once procurement approves terms.
- Procurement contact: Tom Ellis (cc’d) — they require vendor security pack and a completed supplier questionnaire.

3) Timeline:
- Pilot decision: internal sign-off target by March 15
- Pilot start: early April if procurement clears vendor review

Also note Priya will lead security review; Priya, I’ll leave any specific checklist items to you.

Alex
Alex Johnson | CTO, Nimbus Health
Alex.Johnson@nimbushealth.com | (617) 555-2048

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + asks: decision criteria & procurement timeline

Vanessa — we’ll need the following for security review:
- SOC2 Type II report or SOC2 readiness assessment report
- Data processing terms & encryption details (KMS/HSM options)
- Network topology for Private deployment (if we go that route)
- Retention and deletion policies for chat logs and KV cache

If you can share a short security summary and a draft SLA (highlighting uptime SLOs and latency SLOs), I’ll queue it for our vendor security team.

Priya Shah
Head of Information Security | Nimbus Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbushealth.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + asks: decision criteria & procurement timeline

Thanks Alex / Priya — attached is a concise security summary and our draft SLA (see attachments). High level responses to your items: 
- SOC2: Redwood has a SOC2 Type II report; I’ve included the SOC2 summary page in the Nimbus_Security_Summary.pdf and we can coordinate an NDA'd sharing of the full report with procurement.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed KMS for Private and Dedicated; hosted can integrate with common cloud KMS (AWS/GCP).
- Retention: default 30 days for KV/cache; configurable retention policies and enterprise retention options for Dedicated/Private.

On latency/cost: I want to make sure we align with your 95th <= 350ms target. Two questions for you, Alex: 
A) Is that 95th target measured end-to-end from your app through to token generation, or only Redwood's token generation portion?
B) For cost target <$0.015 per effective query, can you share typical token counts per query (prompt+completion avg)? That will let us model Hosted vs Dedicated pricing.

Internal note: looping Aditya and Marissa — likely to need a pilot pricing sheet and possible one-time implementation credits depending on procurement constraints.

Best,
Vanessa

On attachments: Nimbus_Security_Summary.pdf, Draft_SLA_Redwood_v1.docx

From: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@procurement.nimbushealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + asks: decision criteria & procurement timeline

Vanessa — procurement here. Quick clarifications so we can slot your vendor review: 
- Vendor questionnaire: we require an initial vendor packet within two business days of engagement (high-level security summary + sample contract).
- PO/SOW: For pilot, we typically do a PO for the agreed spend and an SOW for scope.
- Pricing ask: please provide two scenarios — Hosted pilot (3 months) and Dedicated pilot (3 months) — each with expected monthly spend estimate and a breakdown by peak throughput (1k qps) and average 200 qps.

Also add a note on cancellation / SLA credits language for pilot. We typically ask for a 30-day termination right for pilots.

Tom Ellis
Senior Procurement Manager | Nimbus Health
procurement@nimbushealth.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@procurement.nimbushealth.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + asks: decision criteria & procurement timeline

Tom — thanks, understood. We will: 
- Send a one-page vendor packet + sample MSA and redlines request today (NDA already signed earlier).
- Provide two pricing scenarios (Hosted vs Dedicated) with monthly spend estimates and cost breakdown for 200 qps avg / 1k qps peak by EOD Wednesday.
- Include proposed pilot SLA language with 30-day termination and SLA credit terms.

Aditya / Marissa — I’ll draft the pricing scenarios and SLA credit language; Marissa, can you prepare a pilot pricing sheet and indicate any flexibility on implementation credits?

Thanks — will keep timelines tight to meet Alex’s March 15 decision target.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
